einzeiler: Why moms burn out, the real causes of Depleted Mother Syndrome, and how to recover.
kurzfassung: Clinical psychologist Rick Hansen and his wife Jan discuss Depleted Mother Syndrome, a combination of physical and emotional exhaustion that often affects mothers years after childbirth. They explore the cumulative toll of raising young children without adequate support, drawing on Jan's personal experience of burnout and nutritional depletion. Finally, they share practical strategies for self-care, relationship teamwork, and rebuilding intimacy.
stichpunkte: Introduction of Jan Hansen and the discussion around maternal burnout.
Jan's personal story of hitting a wall with chronic fatigue and depression when her children were young.
The coining of Depleted Mother Syndrome (DMS) as a biopsychosocial condition.
Why the lowest point of maternal depletion often occurs years after birth, around the child's third or fourth birthday.
The structural and social pressures that leave modern mothers isolated and unsupported.
The importance of physical health checks, including iron and nutrient levels.
Navigating relationship stress, sharing the load, and maintaining intimate friendship after kids.
Practical advice on claiming personal agency, saying yes to help, and prioritizing self-care.

clips.text: A medical professional points out that a mother is sustaining her daily life purely through determination rather than physical reserves.

clips.hook: The lowest point of maternal depletion
clips.text: The speakers outline how mothers in the lower tier experience their deepest slump around the third or fourth birthday of their child.

clips.hook: The necessity of parenting from the same page
clips.text: Couples must align their approach to raising children, otherwise conflicting methods will create chaos within the family.

clips.hook: Challenging assumptions about biology versus culture
clips.text: Many behaviors and reactions are automatically attributed to biological differences when they are actually shaped by cultural norms.

clips.hook: The intense physical toll of raising children
clips.text: Very few life experiences place the same level of physical demand on a human body as pregnancy, childbirth, and nursing.

beschreibung:
Forrest is joined by his parents, psychologist Dr. Rick Hanson and nutritionist Jan Hanson, to discuss "Depleted Mother Syndrome:” the exhaustion, brain fog, and low mood so many mothers experience. They talk about how Jan hit bottom in the years after Forrest and his sister were born, why the hardest stretch often comes two or more years after birth, the problem with dismissing these experiences as "just motherhood,” and how people can recover.
